faqs.question: Is this downloader free to use?
faqs.answer: Yes. There is no cost barrier and no subscription required to download videos or audio.

faqs.question: Do I need to install any software or extension?
faqs.answer: No. The entire experience runs in the browser and does not require additional installations.

faqs.question: Can I download videos in both MP4 and MP3 formats?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can switch between MP4 video or MP3 audio instantly with a single click.

faqs.question: Is my downloaded content stored anywhere?
faqs.answer: No. We do not keep copies or store user downloads. Your data remains private.

faqs.question: Does it work on all browsers and devices?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is optimized to work across major browsers like Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari, Brave, and mobile browsers too.

faqs.question: Why are downloads extremely fast?
faqs.answer: We use highly optimized streaming extraction pipelines which significantly reduce processing time.

faqs.question: Are there watermarks or ads added to the downloaded files?
faqs.answer: No. All downloads are clean, unbranded, and free from watermarks or ads.

faqs.question: Can I download videos from other social media platforms like Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, etc.?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can use our separate platform at https://socialdownloader.in for downloading videos from other social platforms.
